subject: Recap: Cloud channel pricing alignment — token economics & PO mapping
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marco Rossi <marco@datawave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Recap: Cloud channel pricing alignment — token economics & PO mapping

Hi Marco — great conversation earlier today. Quick written recap so we have shared next steps and an initial mapping for PO-based unit economics across marketplaces.

Key takeaways (from your side):
- Current pilot expected to start in April with ~50M tokens/month initial consumption, target to ramp to ~300M tokens/month within 6–9 months.
- Primary workloads: conversational assistants (avg ~350 tokens per call) + batch embedding jobs (sporadic, heavy bursts).
- Procurement preference: use marketplace private offer (PO) where possible for consolidated billing and SSO/entitlement controls.
- Target budget range: $35k–$140k / month across the first-year ramp (flexible based on committed units).

Redwood preliminary unit-price mapping (baseline suggestion for negotiation):
- AWS Marketplace PO: $1,750 / 1M tokens (PO tiered: 0–100M, 100–500M discount bands)
- GCP Marketplace PO: $1,600 / 1M tokens
- Azure Marketplace PO: $1,700 / 1M tokens
- Host API (non-marketplace, volume discount): $1,500 / 1M tokens (reference only)

Why these figures: they reflect marketplace fees + expected channel discounts and small premium for PO settlement complexity. We'll pull exact margin math after you confirm whether DataWave needs token-level retention SLAs or extra audit logging (those change the final band).

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You: confirm whether DataWave will sign a single marketplace PO (preferred) or multiple POs per cloud. Also confirm the committable monthly token band for the first 3 months.
2) Us: we’ll share a draft pricing matrix (attached) with breakpoints and an editable PO template for procurement.
3) Schedule a 30-min pricing & procurement sync with your ProcureOps to walk the PO template & timelines — suggested windows Thu/Fri next week.

I attached a first-pass pricing matrix and the PO template we typically use for marketplace purchases. Ben / Karthik — looping you for suggested adjustments to the unit-price bands or if you want to propose alternate $/1M targets.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for engineering teams

Attachments: redwood-ppu-pricing-matrix.xlsx, acme_po_template.pdf

From: Marco Rossi <marco@datawave.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 10:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap: Cloud channel pricing alignment — token economics & PO mapping

Thanks Laura — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Token volumes: the 50M/month is conservative for month 1 of pilot. If the pilot meets latency/accuracy gates we expect to commit to at least 120M/month for months 2–4, then hitting ~320M/month by month 7. Can you model the pricing at 50/120/320M bands so we can see blended $/1M?

2) Budget: the $35k–$140k range is the business-level cap; procurement will push for predictable blended $/1M not per-cloud variance.

3) Marketplace PO: we prefer a single cross-cloud private offer if Redwood can provide identical SKU/entitlement semantics across AWS/GCP/Azure. If not, we will accept equivalent POs per cloud.

4) Compliance add-ons: we will likely need SOC2 + custom data retention settings on Azure for healthcare workloads — please flag any incremental costs.

ProcureOps is available next Friday (26th) at 14:00 ET for a sync.

Marco
Head of Product, DataWave Analytics
marco@datawave.ai | +39 347 111 2222

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marco Rossi <marco@datawave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, ProcureOps <procureops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 18:41:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap: Cloud channel pricing alignment — token economics & PO mapping

Perfect — thanks for the clarifications. Quick responses inline + action items.

1) Volume modeling: attached matrix includes modeled blended $/1M at 50M, 120M, and 320M monthly consumption across three scenarios (conservative / expected / aggressive). Example blended numbers (expected scenario): AWS PO $1,640 / 1M, GCP PO $1,520 / 1M, Azure PO $1,580 / 1M — blended cross-cloud ~ $1,580 / 1M at 120M. We’ll produce a side-by-side showing how a single cross-cloud PO would change the blended price.

2) Single cross-cloud PO: technically feasible via our channel SKU mapping — the main complexity is marketplace settlement timing and invoice reconciliation. If DataWave wants identical SKUs, Redwood will provide a SKU mapping table + a short ops playbook. No technical feature blockers.

3) Compliance add-ons: SOC 2 attestation is covered; custom data retention/segregation for Azure regional tenancy carries an incremental charge — approximate delta $0.05–$0.15 / 1k tokens depending on retention duration and audit log fidelity. I flagged this in the matrix comments.

4) Proposed MLP (mutual action plan) items:
- This week: you confirm PO approach (single cross-cloud vs per-cloud) and initial committed band for months 1–3.
- Week of Mar 22: Redwood to deliver final pricing matrix with SKU mapping and ops playbook.
- Mar 26 @14:00 ET: Pricing & Procurement call (30 min) with ProcureOps (confirmed).
- Early April: sign PO, kick pilot.

Ben / Karthik — can you review the attached pricing matrix and add an extra column showing the blended price if we run a single cross-cloud PO (same SKU across clouds)? Also, any objections to the SOC2/retention delta being listed as a separate line item (so procurement can see base vs addon)?

Marco — I’ll put the Mar 26 14:00 ET call on the calendar and send an invite with the matrix & playbook attached.

Best,

Laura
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marco Rossi <marco@datawave.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap: Cloud channel pricing alignment — token economics & PO mapping

Sounds good — we confirmed internally and ProcureOps is good for Mar 26 at 14:00 ET. One quick ask before the call: can Redwood include an example blended invoice for the 120M/month expected scenario that shows how costs will break down by cloud and by workload type (assistant vs embeddings)? That will make our procurement review much faster.

Also, we prefer the SOC2/retention delta as a separate line item. Looking forward to the matrix & playbook.

—Marco

(ProcureOps contact: Dana Lee <procureops@acmehealth.com>)
